description: Club founding and changes, replayed by reduceClub (lib/protocol/club-state.ts) as read by `reader`.
format: Events are signed (BIP-340, zero aux randomness) with keys derived as sha256('blueline-vector:' + name). Content keys, nonces and NIP-44 nonces are fixed. Expected outcomes are written by hand from docs/protocol.

cases.name: group-link
cases.description: A closed club: founding, invite and season are sealed for the members. Two people join through the group link with their proof and are members at once.

cases.name: replayed-proof
cases.description: Mallory copies Alice's proof into her own join: worthless for another key. Alice's join arrives twice and counts once; joining again is refused.

cases.name: group-link-with-limit
cases.description: A club for three: the group link only files requests, and the owner decides who gets the places. Carol asked last but is accepted first; the third acceptance is refused because the club is full.

cases.name: personal-invite
cases.description: A personal invite for Tom. Tim got the forwarded link: his proof is valid for his own key, but the invite is used once, by the first acceptance. A later join with it is refused.

cases.name: expired-and-revoked
cases.description: A join after the group link expired, one after it was ended, a second end, a join after a personal invite expired, and an invite that expires before it is made.

cases.name: requests
cases.description: A public club. Asking without an invite waits for an owner or admin: Dave is accepted, Carol declined, Erin withdraws her request. Asking twice, accepting a gone request, an outsider accepting and withdrawing twice are refused.

cases.name: roles
cases.description: Who may do what: the owner appoints an admin, the admin appoints a director and removes a member; a director may not invite, a member may not give roles, an admin may not appoint admins or remove the owner.

cases.name: role-conflict
cases.description: Owner and admin change Alice's role from the same base. The later one is a visible conflict; the admin resolves it on the new base.

cases.name: owner-transfer
cases.description: Ownership changes only by offer and acceptance of the offered member. Afterwards the former owner is an admin and loses what only the owner may do; the club id stays.

cases.name: leave-and-rejoin
cases.description: The owner cannot leave; a member leaves once. A removed member cannot come back with an invite made before the removal, but can with a new one.

cases.name: new-member-reads-history
cases.description: Read by Bob, who joined later: what was sealed before he joined opens through the owner's key share. A key share by a plain member is refused (the keys it carries still only open what they belong to).

cases.name: removed-member
cases.description: Read by Alice after her removal: she still reads what was shared with her and her removal, but nothing sealed afterwards is wrapped for her.

cases.name: closed-club-in-clear
cases.description: In a closed club only a join and a leave may travel in the clear; a season in the clear is refused.

cases.name: closed-founding-in-clear
cases.description: A closed club whose founding travels in the clear does not exist.

cases.name: season-rules
cases.description: Season rules are versioned: free changes before the start, after it only with a visible reason, one version at a time, none after the end.

cases.name: results-and-dates
cases.description: A director decides whether a match result counts for the season and plans dates; a member may do neither. Decisions and dates name their predecessor; nothing is decided after the season's end.

cases.name: unknown-version-and-time
cases.description: A change in a newer format version is kept, not executed. A record dated more than 15 minutes ahead of the reader's clock and one dated before the founding are refused.

cases.name: archived
cases.description: An archived club takes no requests and no new seasons; the owner can still change its details.

cases.name: public-club-read-by-owner
cases.description: A public club: Bob joins through the group link and becomes a director, Carol asks and is accepted. Every reader, members or not, sees the same club, and Bob's club tournament counts.

cases.name: public-club-read-by-mallory
cases.description: A public club: Bob joins through the group link and becomes a director, Carol asks and is accepted. Every reader, members or not, sees the same club, and Bob's club tournament counts.

cases.name: public-club-read-by-carol
cases.description: A public club: Bob joins through the group link and becomes a director, Carol asks and is accepted. Every reader, members or not, sees the same club, and Bob's club tournament counts.

cases.name: closed-club-partial-reader
cases.description: Read by Carol, who joined a closed club later and was given the founding but not the group link: Bob's join stays an unverified request for her until the owner's role change names it, which accepts it for her. The end of the group link waits for the invite she cannot open, a rename waits for the earlier change it builds on that was not wrapped for her; Bob's club tournament counts for her too.

cases.name: former-owner-backdates
cases.description: Alice accepts the ownership; her acceptance names the club details and her own membership as she saw them. Records the former owner dates back afterwards are superseded: withdrawing the accepted offer, offering it to Bob instead, removing Alice and closing the club.

cases.name: ex-admin-backdates
cases.description: The owner demotes an admin; the demotion names the last club change the owner saw. A rename the former admin dates back into their admin time afterwards is superseded; a demotion without that pin is refused. Removing a member is not pinned: the former admin's backdated removal still counts (documented limit, conflicts.md).

cases.name: member-limit
cases.description: A closed club without its own capacity holds at most 100 members (every sealed record is wrapped for each of them). The group link admits 99 people; the next join becomes a request, accepting it is refused while the club is full and works once a member has left.

cases.name: backdated-join
cases.description: A join dated before the invite it names is refused: nobody can have held that link yet.
